findings.text: follow-on: the except TypeError around ledger.load(headers_only=True) is unreachable because reckon/ledger.py:1049 declares headers_only a real keyword, so the fallback is a defensive shim no test can exercise.

follow-on: _crew_plan_details re-implements the 16384-byte head slice and </head> split that _plan_html.parse_meta already owns and memoises (reckon/_plan_html.py:1571), then runs the un-memoised BeautifulSoup read_state, so the fast path can cost more than parse_meta on a repeated read of the same plan.

justifications.evidence: both assertions in tests/test_a_launched_run_reads_launching_on_crew.py redden on their reinstated defects, the stream-only control at negative-control.log (EXIT=1) and the base arm at review-base-timing-final.log (2.041 s), and both are recorded.
